jobs_results.description:
Posición: Senior React Native Engineer - Peer Experiences

About Gartner Peer Experiences (Peer Community and Peer Insights):

Gartner Peer Community is a peer-driven platform where thousands of verified enterprise leaders connect with each other to help guide technology and business decisions. Users can network, share knowledge, get advice, and stay on top of current trends in the technology space. By posting questions, polls and surveys, leaders have access to real-time data and insights to inform their most critical decisions.

Gartner Peer Insights is a peer-driven platform that allows users to access peer technology ratings and reviews by verified users, filter based on reviewer metadata for the most relevant insights, and compare similar products to select the best tool for their needs.

About the role:

This is a unique opportunity for a systematic, technically strong, and driven individual to make a big impact on Gartner’s peer experiences roadmap as part of the Gartner... Product Management group. We are looking for impact-driven, self-motivated problem solvers bringing Frontend (web and/or mobile) or Full Stack experience.

Peer experiences is a very important initiative at Gartner to make it faster and easier for clients to obtain peer insights. This role will work closely with the company leadership as well as the product, design, and QA teams to implement the product roadmap and help improve the client experience. You will also help mentor team members and help with the release process.

What you will do:
• Assume major responsibility for Peer Insights community user-facing platforms.
• Participate actively in architectural planning and decisions.
• Design and build client-side architecture and functionality for web and mobile.
• Design and build effective APIs and scalable backend systems.
• Work closely with Design and Product teams to build a truly useful product.
• Understand user requirements and help understand and provide input into product strategy.
• Build and enforce guidelines for clean maintainable code.
• Join a growing organization on the ground floor.

What you will need:

Must have:
• Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, math, statistics, engineering or related field is preferred.
• 5+ years of experience using React Native
• Proven track record of building scalable, modular and understandable solutions.
• Analytical problem solving skills, driven mindset, and a bias for action.
• Intuitive sense for design/usability.

Nice to have / opportunity to learn (depending on the team)
• Ability to operate independently and produce thorough solutions given vague product and design requirements.
• Strong sense of ownership and drive to help execute our product roadmap.
• You are stoked about working with data, visualizations and graphs.
• Strong working knowledge of lean product principles and software development lifecycle.
• Verbal English skills (we work in English!)

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

How we work:
• We work with a focus on continuous, iterative delivery.
• We rely on communication and collaboration over planning and documents.
• We test heavily allowing us to rapidly deliver changes with minimal risk.
• We are a flat organization with minimal management overhead.
• We are used to working remotely with the team spread out in the US, Canada, India and now Spain.
• Fun culture and great coworkers.

What you will get:
• Competitive compensation.
• 23 days annual holiday and an additional day off for your birthday.
• And much more!
• Private Medical and Dental Care.
• Life and Disability Insurance.
• Public Transport Subsidy.
• Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Childcare Vouchers (Ticket Guarderia).
• Incenti Fit - annual reimbursement for health-and-wellness-related activities.
• Pension Scheme.
• Tuition Reimbursement.
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
• Employee Assistance Program.
• Gartner Gives Charity Match.
• Relocation Assistance - a specialist to help you with all the appointments and paperwork.
• Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
• A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
• A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
• A hybrid work environment—enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
• New offices close to Glòries and the beach in the fantastic, “innovation and tech” 22@ district of sunny Barcelona.
• Fresh fruit, snacks, selection of teas, fair trade organic coffee and a fridge full of beer for our Thursday Beer O’Clock.

And much more!

Please note:

• Applications must be submitted in English.

• A valid EU visa/passport is required for this position.

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Introduction

We’re looking for an experienced software developer to work on our cloud hosted SaaS platform. We are the creators of Matomo, the leading open source web analytics solution that gives people full control of their data and built-in privacy. We have challenges to solve and need you!

We are fully remote and we collaborate online. We are a small, flexible team, and when you come onboard you will play an integral part in engineering. You’ll help us to make our products better and deliver a great experience to our customers.

Your daily activities includes
• Maintaining, deploying, monitoring and improving our AWS hosted SaaS web analytics platform
• Keeping the platform secure, fast, always available, and up to date
• Taking ownership of technical issues, and work with the team to resolve more advanced issues when necessary
• Documenting the infrastructure and processes
• Be On-Call on a rotational basis (two thirds of the time, including nights and... weekends)

Qualifications
• 5+ years commercial experience in product development with PHP
• Strong competency in PHP, SQL performance optimisation and security best practices
• Proficient with Linux command line
• Skilled at writing automated tests and reviewing code
• Experience with JavaScript
• Strong analytical skills and a passion for it to understand complex business logic
• Great communication and collaboration skills
• Ability to work independently
• Willing to provide on-call support

Location
• 100% Remote work position (European candidates must be willing to work a minimum of 4 hours overlapping with New Zealand per week)

Benefits
• Remote work (save many hours on commute, and save money)
• Co-working space paid for and/or work from home
• All home office equipment paid for (laptop, desk, chair, standing desk, lights, etc.)
• Flexible hours
• 25 days of paid holidays per year plus your national public holidays
• Sick leave
• Health Insurance: Your well-being is our priority
• A huge “playground” to grow your skill set
• Volunteering Day: Empower your impact
• Bereavement Leave for Pets: Compassion beyond boundaries
• Training Opportunities
• Mental Health Support Services

About InnoCraft And Matomo Analytics

At InnoCraft, we offer analytics products and SaaS to enable our users to grow their business. We believe in openness, privacy and 100% data ownership. Our mission is to liberate analytics and we are passionate about measuring for success. That’s why we created Matomo Analytics, the leading open source analytics platform used on more than 1 million websites and apps in over 150 countries, available in more than 50 languages. The Matomo platform collects, stores and processes a lot of information: hundreds of millions of data points each month. We create intuitive, simple and beautiful reports that delight our users.

We celebrate the things that make you, you! We are an inclusive employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status or disability. We actively seek diversity in our workplace and embrace individuals with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities!

Come join our growing team that’s helping ensure a safer, more privacy focused web/internet!

jobs_results.title: Mid/Senior Software Engineer, Backend/Frontend, IKEA for Business...
jobs_results.location: San Sebastián de los Reyes, Spain
jobs_results.description:
Hej, we are Álvaro, David and Ramón. We lead the team as Engineering Managers at IKEA for Business, and we want you to join us! Let us explain why.

We are looking for true team players, that care about the work they do and are not afraid to share ideas and chase opportunities. We are curious and always looking for creative ways to reach new goals and remove obstacles. We care about details and know what it takes to deliver great-quality applications.

If you join us, you will take part and influence strategic decisions regarding the design, construction, distribution and maintenance of cloud-based solutions for our business. You will have the opportunity to join a multidisciplinary team (Product, Data, UX and Engineering) and contribute to the design and development of IKEA’s B2B global landscape of solutions since their early stages of development (our hub was founded less than 2 years ago!)

At IKEA we have a vision to help more of the many people to have an affordable and better... everyday life at home and be more convenient to where they are. At the same time, we aspire to become truly people and planet-positive. Come and join our family!

To succeed as an Engineer with us if you have experience working in an Agile and DevOps working set-up, you get energized by delivering high-quality software and love contributing to our Engineering culture. We expect you to have knowledge and be willing to contribute to frontend or backend development plus provide advice to other team members. You will also be willing to develop user stories end-to-end.

Some of your main responsibilities will include:

• Development using Microservices technology (Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless, etc... Especially in GCP)
• Develop software in some of the following technologies: HTML / CSS; JavaScript; TypeScript; React-Angular-Vue; Python; Java; Node.js; SQL.
• Collaborate on the definition and implementation of our CD/CI processes.
• Contributing to setting up the organization and defining our ways of working (Design patterns, clean code enthusiast, MVC model, …)
• Collaborate Cross-team between app, cloud & backend, and embedded systems teams
• Bringing in third-party open-source tools and libraries as needed
• Prototyping new ideas, both individually and across teams (we love prototyping and MVP!)

The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com or just watch this movie: https://vimeo.com/290339889.

WHAT IS THE ICING ON THE CAKE?

You will be a part of a great culture as well as our vision “to create a better everyday life for the many people” – for customers, but also for our co-workers and the people who work for our suppliers. You will work and thrive in a true people and planet-positive work environment. 

Some of the perks that we offer: 

• A workplace where you can always be yourself  
• Equal pay (Our salaries are set independently of race, gender, age or other individual characteristics) 
• Continuous learning on the job as well as structured training and platforms 
• Co-worker discount 
• Access to health insurance 
• World’s greatest colleagues

OUR TEAM WITHIN IKEA
Within the New Business domain, IKEA For Business aims to become the preferred partner for the success of numerous businesses.

B2B represents a proven opportunity with an ambitious growth plan, our focus now is on expanding our product offerings to new markets. Our mission: to deliver a digitally-enabled, end-to-end experience tailored for businesses, while providing timely assistance.

As part of a global digital team, our product teams are engaged in developing various B2B digital products and capabilities across diverse functional areas, such as business intelligence, e-commerce, CRM, and customer master data. We aim to continue creating even better B2B value propositions, omnichannel experiences and attracting more potential business customers to IKEA.

QUESTIONS AND SUPPORT? LET'S CONNECT!
If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please reach out to Warren Roach at warren.roach@ingka.com
Any questions about the role, don't hesitate to contact the hiring manager, Ramón Montero at ramon.montero@ingka.ikea.com.

We look forward to hearing from you

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Java
jobs_results.description:
ADP is hiring several Junior Backend Developers.

In this role, you will join a team to build and debug ADP’s cloud-based payroll, tax, HR, and benefits solutions to help our customers save time, stay compliant and manage costs.

No two days are the same. You will work alongside a team of other passionate, creative developers to complete sprints identified during scrum meetings, where we tackle problems and prioritise what we code next. From concept to code, you’ll spend your days building new features and upgrades supporting business clients that employ anywhere from one to one million employees.

To thrive in this coding career, you’ll need to enjoy leaning new things and adapting to new languages and tools, both, industry standard and propriety. You’ll also need experience working with front-end, scripting, and back-end. You don’t need to know every tool, but you’re an enthusiastic creator who stays current and looks forward to trying new code. You’re always looking for that next... best thing to make tools better..

Integrity, resilience, creativity and team spirit are must-haves in this job.
You'll learn new things, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry.

Like what you see?Apply now!

A little about ADP: We are a global leader in HR technology, offering the latest AI and machine learning-enhanced payroll, tax, HR, benefits, and much more. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive, down-to-earth culture that welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We’ve received recognition as a global Best Places to Work, and as a recipient of many prestigious awards for diversity, equity, and inclusion, including a Diversity Inc Top 50 Company, Best CEO and company for women, LGBTQ+, multicultural talent, and more.

Learn more about DEI at ADP on our You Tube channel: (Usted puede enviar una solicitud o contactar con nosotros por email usando el Buzón de Solicitud online de abajo).

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Here’s what you can expect on a typical day in the life of a Lead Full Stack Developer at ADP.
• We’ll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, issues, and communicate coding priorities. As a Full Stack Developer, you’ll do more than code, you’ll communicate the intricacies and problems at hand.
• Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards.
• Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could work on anything from migrations to delivering new features, product enhancements, or creating new services.
• We’re always learning new codes and operating with a “figure it out” mentality.
• We’re working on products with tech that we’ve never used before. Inevitable challenges will arise, and we’ll rely on you to look for a solution.
• You’ll work in a continuous development environment using Git/Bitbucket and automatic build and testing.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

A degree is great but not required. What’s more important is having the skills to do the job.

We are hiring a Junior Java developer (additional Kotlin experience would be a plus)
With knowledge of Spring Boot, Docker Containers, Object Oriented programming to develop on Backend

In either case you will have a logically minded approach, you will be adaptable and willing to learn with a high attention to details.

Nice-to-have: SQL knowledge,

Experience with automation, experience of working with with Cucumber or similar BDD tools, passionate about code performance and quality,
passionate about delivering best user experience, familiar with Test-Driven Development.

YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
• Team collaboration. You will be supported by, and you will support a team, with a strong spirit of knowledge sharing and mutual assistance.
• Challenge your solutions. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another’s ideas to net out the best solution.
• Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We’re obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
• Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
• Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
• Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP’s Philanthropic Foundation.
• Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

What are you waiting for?Apply today!

Hi, we’re DuckDuckGo, the Internet privacy company for everyone who wants to take back their privacy now. For over a decade, we've been building our all-in-one product, developing new privacy technology, and working with policymakers to make online privacy simple and accessible for all.

Our browsers and extensions have been downloaded over 250 million times with our built-in private search engine, which has delivered over 100 billion searches and is the 2nd largest search engine on mobile in the United States and 17 other countries, including the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Germany, Poland, and Spain. Our private search engine is also 3rd in market share in the U.S. and over 20 major markets. Oh, and we've been profitable since 2014, with annual revenue exceeding $100 million!

The DuckDuckGo browser’s uniquely comprehensive privacy protections are used by tens of millions of people to protect their everyday online activities on Mac, Windows, iOS, and... Android, from searching to browsing, emailing, and more. We also offer Privacy Pro, a three-in-one subscription service that includes a VPN, Personal Information Removal, and Identity Theft Restoration.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Windows Desktop App to help shape our all-in-one privacy solution and join our mission to show the world that protecting your privacy online can be simple.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will work on the team responsible for launching our first ever DuckDuckGo Privacy App for Windows. You'll collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers across Native Apps to craft a world-class browser with embedded privacy features that will revolutionize the way people search, surf, and exist online.

You will be critical to the successful launch of this product and responsible for taking pieces of the puzzle and autonomously building solutions to get us closer to our first release. You will help define the roadmap, take ownership of significant application features and experiment with ways to improve them.

You will lay the foundations of what will become one of DuckDuckGo's flagship products and critical levers for growing privacy online.

What You Will Bring To DuckDuckGo
• Experience implementing ideas from scratch, owning major application features, and taking responsibility for their maintenance and improvement over time.
• Experience participating in technical architecture decisions for complex products, essentially shaping the software architecture of a consumer product.
• Experience building at least one desktop application (ideally with WPF, UWP, WinUI, WinForms, or other relevant .NET UI).
• An advanced level of programming expertise, with knowledge of C#. We currently use .NET 6.
• A significant level of experience in building customer facing applications, including crafting user interfaces.
• Deep understanding of software design patterns such as MVVM, MVP, etc.
• Event-driven programming (e.g., using Rx.NET) experience is considered an advantage.

How We Will Support You

Our core values -- build trust, question assumptions, and validate direction -- underpin how we work day-to-day and the support we give our team members. We strive to empower our team members to be self-directed and self-motivated in their work.
• Remote First, Always: We've always been a fully distributed company with team members all over the world. We trust you to get your work done wherever, whenever.
• Commitment to Personal Growth: Every team member has an annual budget of $1,250 USD to invest in their professional development. Every team member also has a dedicated Career Advisor, who serves as a guide to help you develop your strengths, identify your motivations, and understand your opportunities for growth.
• Leadership: We have many different types of leaders and possible combinations of leadership roles, so you can grow your career in a way that aligns best with your personal goals. You can seek additional leadership roles by being directly responsible for projects, taking ownership of areas of the company, developing and maintaining internal processes, or pursuing advisory roles.
• Work/Life Balance: Team members have the freedom and flexibility to organize their own work schedules. We want you to thrive both in and out of the office. We trust you to use good judgment and take the time off that you need to bring your best self to work.

We also offer paid parental leave, a co-working stipend, office setup reimbursement, and a wellness stipend. More support resources can be found in our, Team Member Support Guide, which explains how we make your well-being a priority.

For more information on how we collaborate worldwide, from leadership in our relatively flat organization to start-to-finish ownership, check out DuckDuckGo Culture: How We Work.

Compensation

Annual compensation: $176,000 USD and stock options. Compensation is the same within a professional level, regardless of geographic location or functional area, and the compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization.

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo and envision your future role here. Find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

If you think you might thrive in this environment, we would love to hear from you.

Please note that:
• Sometimes we meet up! Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
• While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
• A successful candidate will be subject to a background check and must receive satisfactory results of the same, as a condition of joining the team.
• By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

jobs_results.description:
YOUR CHALLENGE:

As a Senior Software Engineer - Backend (f/m/d), you will join one of our most innovative teams: Dispatching. This team doesn’t solve your common every-day problems! With the aid of algorithms and graph theory, they define on a daily basis how we utilise our dedicated fleet at Blacklane in the best way possible. With your strong background in software engineering and deep understanding of product development principles, you will play a vital role in the success of our team!

Our environment is composed of Java, Go, TypeScript and React. These services are deployed to our Kubernetes cluster. As data storage we use SQL databases. We work together with other teams to ensure a smooth programming experience and use the data available to make the best decisions possible for our customers.

Additionally, you will:
• Take a leading role in shaping the product, architectural design and development of our systems.
• Mentor and foster a culture of continuous learning with your... colleagues
• Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to ensure code quality and help your teammates grow
• Utilise your strong problem-solving skills to solve complex technical issues
• Stay updated with the latest advancements and emerging technologies and aid their integration into our projects
• Collaborate with product and design to implement intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that enhance the overall user experience
• Lead conversations: Communicate across teams and our stakeholders to understand the big picture as mobile products extend to the services they use
• Solve very compelling problems and push the capabilities of our systems further and further.
• Ensure a good test coverage, write documentation when needed, engaging in code reviews and knowledge sharing.

ABOUT YOU:
• You are proactive, curious, and a team player. You love to solve complex problems and tackle them in a pragmatic manner.
• You have a strong understanding of product development and are capable of translating our stakeholders needs proactively into new features.
• You have a solid understanding of algorithms and graph theory.
• You are comfortable working with multiple programming languages and have a solid understanding of and experience with either Java or Go.
• You have a solid understanding of SQL databases.
• Ideally, you also have an appetite for visualising the state of the systems

MORE THAN A JOB:

Blacklane is a scale-up started in 2011, founded by Jens Wohltorf and Frank Steuer who wanted to create the first global chauffeur service. We started by filling chauffeurs’ ‘empty leg’ journeys and have grown with our partners to over €100 million in annual revenue (pre-pandemic). Backed by Daimler and other investors in Germany, Japan, Switzerland, and the UAE, we’re now a trusted brand within corporate travel.

We believe in ethical business practices and have a strong company culture.
• Continuous Learning: We believe that open and actionable feedback is the essential component of continuous development. Set your personal development plan and take an active role in our internal learning communities to progress your career.
• Flexible Working: Even the most ambitious Blacklaner needs some time to unwind. Find out what works for you and your team with flexible working hours and home office days.
• Become Part of the Crew: Get to know your fellow Blacklaners through our regular team socials. Our success comes from a collaboration of more than 350 people from 70 nations and we are looking for more exceptional people to join us!
• Employee Stock Options Plan: We want all Blacklaners to benefit from the company's success, so every employee gets virtual stock options.
• Fair Remuneration: We’ve banded salary levels and matched them to the local costs of living, meaning you’re always paid fairly and you know that the rest of the crew is too.
• Sustainability: We care for both people and the planet, having launched the mobility's industry-first global carbon offset scheme in 2017. Blacklane has pledged to deliver 15% of its journeys in electric vehicles by 2023.
• Equal Opportunity: We are committed to inclusion and diversity. A company is only as strong as its crew, so we developed a work environment that is inclusive, inspiring and open. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
• Blacklane Cares day: Every crew member receives 8 hours of paid leave per year to participate in volunteering initiatives of their choice or lead employee-driven community outreach projects. Utilize your time to lend hands to a cause that drives your passion.

Upgrade your career with Blacklane

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
jobs_results.description:
The mission of the inbox team is to manage alerts coming from any system, service or infrastructure for organizations. This means having to sort thousands of alerts everyday, from dozens of disparate monitoring tools. They need to centralize these alerts into a single place, and filter and prioritize the most critical ones for immediate escalation into incidents. The goal of inbox is to organize all of these alerts in one place and support the above workflow of filtering, prioritizing and remediating these alerts.

As a front end focused Full Stack Software Engineer on the team, you will help bootstrap a fast-moving product team. You will be the first frontend engineer on the team and will build and scale new features for the product. Join us to build the next generation of high-scale, data-powered features for our customers.

Full stack engineers work across the Datadog backend and frontend—python, go, postgres, cassandra, and more on the backend and Typescript/React on the... frontend—to build and scale new features for the core Datadog web application.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:
• Implement compelling, usable UIs; contribute to their design; and engineer them with React
• Work on a fast moving team and help ship a brand new product from 0 to 1
• Work across the stack to deliver new features from start-to-finish
• Build clean, performant APIs to power data visualizations

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero Electrónico Senior
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos un experto en electrónica, ingeniero senior con más de 10 años de experiencia, que tenga altas capacidades en diseño y desarrollo electrónico. Trabajará con el resto de ingenieros de nuestro equipo en diferentes desarrollos de nuestra tecnología RSD.

TU MISIÓN:
• Trabajar con el equipo de ingeniería de Opus RSE en Madrid en diferentes desarrollos tecnológicos.
• Liderar diferentes desarrollos electrónicos, con alta autonomía y un excelente trabajo en equipo.
• Aportar tus capacidades para mejorar una tecnología única en el mundo, pero que está en continua mejora.

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS:
• Idiomas: nivel total de fluidez en español y muy buen nivel en inglés.
• Educación: universitaria en ingeniería electrónica.
• Experiencia en desarrollo de Firmware (microchip PIC32) y DSP.
• Experiencia en desarrollos electrónicos de altas prestaciones y de arquitecturas complejas, incluyendo FPGA.
• Experiencia en reparación de tarjetas electrónicas (soldadura, testeo, etc.).
• Experiencia... en puesta a punto de equipos y pruebas (generación de reportes e informes).
• Experiencia en diseño HW a nivel esquemático con herramientas como LTSpice o similar.
• Experiencia en diseño de PCBs y circuitos.
• Conocimientos generales de firmware y programación en C.
• Alta capacidad de trabajo proactivo, llevando desarrollos tanto en solitario como con el resto de ingenieros.

REQUISITOS ADICIONALES DESEABLES:
• Experiencia demostrada en la coordinación técnica de equipos de ingeniería.
• Experiencia demostrada en ejecutar proyectos de desarrollo a alta velocidad y bajo elevados estándares de calidad.
• Experiencia en programación de microcontroladores Microchip.
• Experiencia en programación de aplicaciones de escritorio para testing de hardware.
• Experiencia en la búsqueda y gestión de proveedores.
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de nuevos productos.
• Experiencia en generación de documentación técnica (manuales, fichas técnicas, informes técnicos, etc.).

LO QUE OFRECEMOS:
• Incorporación inmediata.
• Empresa sólida y en rápida expansión. Una empresa y un producto únicos en todo el mundo. Somos una pequeña empresa "boutique" española, integrada en una gran empresa internacional de 2,600 empleados, con oficinas en 34 países.
• Un ambiente de trabajo espectacular, con compañeros de muy alto nivel en sus diferentes especialidades y gran valor humano. Aprenderás de los mejores.
• Un reto desafiante. Un lugar con un ritmo cambiante y proyectos innovadores, que impulsará tu carrera y tus capacidades.
• Salario competitivo de acuerdo con la experiencia y la habilidad

Nombre de vacante Senior Engineer Descripción We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UI Engineer (ideally full stack or with backend knowledge) to join our Service Fabric team in Barcelona.

Service Fabric is a technology platform that enables Sage to deliver common capabilities required across multiple Sage cloud or cloud-connected products.

As a Senior Engineer, you are going to collaborate in the design, develop and delivery of high-quality products and services that exceed customers’ or business partners’ expectations.

You will be part of a team inside Sage’s global Service Fabric organisation, located in multiple countries around the globe. You’ll be part of a dynamic team focused on integration and enablement activities. Responsabilidades principal... es Your responsibilities will be to:

• Design and develop user interfaces for web applications (mobile friendly), using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related front-end frameworks such as React and/or Angular

• Collaborate with designers, product managers, and back-end developers to ensure a seamless user experience

• Translate UI/UX design wireframes into high-quality code

• Develop reusable UI components and libraries

• Optimize user interfaces for performance and responsiveness

• Mentor and lead other engineers in the team

• Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality standards

• Improve code quality by implementing best practices and design patterns

• Communicate with other teams to understand requirements and propose solutions

We would love to meet you if you:

• Have developed using a variety of technologies, with experience in front-end frameworks - React and/or Angular.

• Hands-on experience in .NET backend development. Knowledge of Node.

JS

• Keen interest in learning new programming languages and tools.

• You enjoy reading code and fully understanding the environment in which it runs, from the network stack to the back-end storage layers and everything in between.

• Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment

• Experience working with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes

• Familiarity with development and deployment of cloud-based products

Independently of your technical profile and background, we put value on collaboration and communication skills, displaying an agile mindset and having reasonable amounts of autonomy and accountability.

Why you would love to join us?

Impact:
You’ll be working alongside a tremendous team of highly skilled engineers on products that make a real impact on our customers.

Culture:

You will be working in a multicultural and diverse environment.

Environment:
Fantastic tech environment, using the best of breed and cutting-edge technologies.

Community:
Make a difference to communities we live and work in, with your 5 volunteer days every year. How we are making a difference

Continuous Development:
Unlimited access to Pluralsight, Linkedin Learning and Sage University.

Career Growth:
Long-term prospects for a professional career. Access to Talent Marketplace, an internal system that uses artificial intelligence to create a clear path for growth.

The flexible Human Work approach will provide you an opportunity to unlock all forms of flexibility (mode, location, and time).

Brand office space, locates at the heart of Barcelona’s 22@tech district, with great transport links.

Reduced working hours in the summer.

Flexible benefits that suit your needs.

Ready to take up this challenge? Apply today or contact us for more information.
